Yasons Chemex Care Ltd trades at a steep discount with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.46x, meaning the market prices the stock at less than half its book value of ₹ 21.5 per share [E2]. This massive valuation disconnect occurs despite a micro-cap market capitalisation of ₹ 19.2 Cr [E3] that is paired with explosive top-line expansion, evidenced by a 3-year compounded sales growth rate of 38% [E8] and a trailing twelve month sales growth of 27% [E9]. Operational momentum is further highlighted by screen reasons pointing directly to robust year-over-year sales surges exceeding 50% [E49] alongside strong overall sales growth [E50] and short-term profit growth catalysts exceeding 20% YoY [E52]. Conceded: compounded profit growth stands at -35% over 3 years [E10] and -42% over the trailing twelve months [E11], alongside a low ROCE of 5.3% [E6] and ROE of 2.3% [E7]. Nevertheless, the current P/E ratio of 20.4 [E1] severely under-appreciates a business scaling its revenues at this velocity.
